purpose: Define the bidirectional flow grammar of the D1-D11 Axis so the Atlas can place residue, obligations, recurrence, repair, growth, transmission and integration consistently without confusing project symbolism with empirical physics.
boundary: D1-D11 polarity is project-symbolic and analytical. Lower/upper, hell/heaven, magnetism, light and karmic flow are not physical altitude, measurable spiritual force or scientific electromagnetism. Empirical money, energy, goods, people, data and legal obligations keep their own units, sources and direction and must never be numerically merged with symbolic/karmic quantities.

master_law.axis_mundi: One vertical connective structure can be read comparatively as Axis Mundi, Yggdrasil/world tree, Tree of Life, Ladder and project Axis, while preserving the differences among those traditions and the Potatoverse synthesis.
master_law.earth_anchor: D4 is the observable world. Real countries, cities, institutions, companies, infrastructure, populations, money and material flows remain here even when a vertical interpretation is added.
master_law.junction: D5 is the Door: the controlled routing point where a relation may move toward integration/growth, return to D4, remain unresolved or descend toward recurrence/disintegration.
master_law.upward_gradient: Ascent trends toward narrower convergence, clarified relation, transformed recurrence, autonomous generativity, faithful transmission, integrated perspective, unity and source-facing orientation.
master_law.downward_gradient: Descent trends toward broader dispersion, sedimentation, unresolved obligation, blocked flow, orbit/capture, recurrence, opacity, fragmentation, disintegration and dust/ash imagery.
master_law.important_asymmetry: Down is not identical to evil and up is not automatically good. Roots, burial, memory, seed and stored potential can be generative below D4; Mountain or summit views can become domination if integration does not return as accountable service. Direction is determined by transformation and function, not location alone.

placement_invariants.geography: Physical or institutional location belongs to D4 even when an object participates in a lower or higher project-symbolic interpretation.
placement_invariants.relation_not_person: Downward states such as Swamp, capture or disintegration are properties of represented relationships/system dynamics, not permanent identities assigned to people, populations, religions or countries.
placement_invariants.roots_are_a_fork: D3 may feed downward through unresolved activation or upward through provenance, context, Soil and usable memory. Burial/root position alone does not determine valence.
placement_invariants.upward_requires_output: Promotion toward D7-D11 should be supported by actual branching capacity, composition, faithful relay, integration or criterion-level work; spiritual vocabulary alone is insufficient.
placement_invariants.return_to_earth: Upper-layer claims are incomplete unless the user can descend back to D4 consequences, sources or observable outcomes.

breadth_law.downward: broader / more dispersed / more branching degrees of unresolved relation
breadth_law.upward: narrower / more convergent / fewer degrees of unresolved dispersion

tree_crosswalk.deep_roots: D1-D3 contain closed depth, Swamp, ash, buried residue, memory, causes and roots of strife/potential.
tree_crosswalk.trunk_world: D4-D6 form the Earth/trunk/Door/Ladder transition region where real relations are observed and routed through thresholds or transformed recurrence.
tree_crosswalk.living_crown: D7-D11 move through branching Life, Garden/Rooms, transmission/light, integrated Crown and North-of-North orientation.
tree_crosswalk.cycle: seed -> burial/rooting -> Door/transition -> spiral growth -> tree/fruit -> future seed; failed processing can instead produce ash -> Mud -> Swamp -> deeper disintegration.

empirical.rule: Retain direction, quantity, compatible units, time and source. These flows may be projected through Axis operators but remain empirical records.

social_relational.rule: Represent as typed relations with evidence and uncertainty. Do not assign pseudo-physical units unless a real operational metric exists.

project_symbolic.rule: Keep in project_interpretation or explicitly project-canon records. Symbolic amounts and polarity may not overwrite or sum with financial/legal quantities.

magnetism_grammar.attraction: A relation draws actors/resources/attention toward a common center, obligation or repeating interaction.
magnetism_grammar.repulsion: A relation increases separation, exclusion or avoidance between endpoints.
magnetism_grammar.orbit_capture: Attraction plus recurrence without meaningful transformation; the relation keeps circling the same center or archive.
magnetism_grammar.convergence: Many relations become more coherent around a shared criterion, source, repair pathway or integrated system.
magnetism_grammar.dispersion: A relation fragments into more disconnected, opaque or mutually incompatible branches.
magnetism_grammar.release: A formerly binding obligation or capture relation is closed, repaired, settled or made non-coercive while provenance remains visible.

obligation_flow.downward_pattern: unresolved event -> residue -> repeated activation -> mixed provenance -> attributed obligation -> compounding/capture -> blocked exit -> disintegration
obligation_flow.upward_pattern: event -> provenance -> classification -> accountable attribution -> repair/settlement -> release -> restored agency -> generativity/service
obligation_flow.closure_rule: An obligation changes state through explicit closure conditions, not because the interface labels it positive or negative.
obligation_flow.debt_firewall: Financial/legal debt, social obligation and project-symbolic karmic debt are separate domains unless a validated conversion method exists.

computable_observable_vector.purpose: Provide future empirical/analytical signals for Axis-adjacent views without inventing one universal holiness, karma or moral score.
computable_observable_vector.rule: Keep these as a vector of separately sourced measurements. Never collapse them into a single heaven/hell rank without an explicit domain model, weighting rationale, uncertainty and validation.

signals.recurrence: Repeated activation frequency or repeated edge interaction when timestamps exist.
signals.exit_friction: Observed/modelled difficulty of leaving a relation or system, using state.agency.exit_cost or domain-specific evidence.
signals.provenance_resolution: Share/quality of claims or traces with identifiable sources, dates and contradiction handling.
signals.open_obligation: Count/value of unresolved obligations within one compatible obligation domain; never mix financial and project-symbolic units.
signals.closure_fraction: Share of scoped obligations/edges whose documented closure state is substantially_repaired, released or closed.
signals.autonomous_capacity: Whether downstream nodes gain independent capability rather than permanent dependency.
signals.relay_fidelity: Source-to-recipient preservation only where a domain defines a testable signal/message and comparison method.
signals.integration_loss: What information is hidden when many lower-level records are compressed into a Mountain/system aggregate.
signals.branching_or_dispersion: Graph fan-out, fragmentation or disconnected components where network topology is actually represented.

hydrological_crosswalk.sediment: Mud / unresolved residue carried by flow
hydrological_crosswalk.stagnation: Swamp / blocked or recursively circulating accumulation
hydrological_crosswalk.drain: downward outflow that may clear residue or reduce agency depending on design/context
hydrological_crosswalk.watershed: Mountain/high ground organizing direction and integration
hydrological_crosswalk.irrigation: directed flow that supports Garden/generative capacity
hydrological_crosswalk.soil: processed residue that becomes usable context, memory or capacity rather than recurring contamination

1.label: Deep Lower Plane
outflow: only through recovered exit, truth-test, boundary, accountability or repair pathway
1.risk: treating a temporary or disputed relation as permanently terminal

2.label: Swamp / Disintegration
outflow: more recurrence unless exit/provenance/repair channels open
2.risk: using Swamp as a moral label for a population instead of a relation/system-state

3.label: Roots of Ash
3.risk: assuming stored history automatically determines present causation

4.label: Earth / World Map
4.risk: allowing symbolic polarity to masquerade as empirical geography

5.label: North Door / First Heaven
5.risk: treating a symbolic threshold as automatic judgment

7.label: Tree of Life
7.risk: assuming every increase or expansion is healthy fruit

8.label: Garden / Rooms
8.flow_behavior: compose / circulate / cultivate among differentiated rooms
8.risk: forced unity that destroys differentiation or agency

9.label: Angels / Seeds of Light
9.risk: distortion, proxy capture or claiming supernatural transmission as measured fact

10.label: Heaven / Crown
10.flow_behavior: compress / evaluate / orient / descend as service

11.label: North of North
11.flow_behavior: select criteria / unify orientation / test invariants
outflow: criteria that must descend through D10 service into D4 consequences
11.risk: using meta-orientation to escape empirical testing or claim political authority

placement_rules: Keep real subcultures/platforms/communities on D4 as empirical nodes; D2 applies only to evidenced/project-interpreted feedback, capture and recurrence dynamics.
Keep real financial/legal obligations on D4/D3/D5 with amounts, units, dates and sources; karmic debt remains project-symbolic even if monetary language is used.
Use D3 for residue/provenance before assigning downward causation or obligation.
Use D5 whenever a relation changes regime: settlement, release, accession, authorization, refusal, repair threshold or other guarded transition.
Use D7-D10 only when downstream generativity, composition, transmission or integration can be shown; do not promote content upward merely because it sounds spiritual.
Every D10/D11 interpretation should retain a navigation path back to D4 evidence and consequences.

transition_model.principle: A state is not a D-level. D1-D11 names transformation regimes; states name the current relational condition. The same state may be inspected across more than one level, and movement is conditional rather than automatic.

observed.label: Observed relation
observed.description: A relation, event, obligation or pattern located in the empirical world with sourceable facts and consequences.

residue.label: Residue / Ash
residue.description: What remains after an event: memory, records, grief, obligation, provenance, causal hypotheses and stored consequence.
questions: What is cause, context or merely adjacency?

unresolved.label: Unresolved activation
unresolved.description: Residue repeatedly reactivated without sufficient classification, closure or changed relation.
questions: What is still unclassified, unacknowledged or unsettled?

capture.label: Capture / Swamp loop
capture.description: A self-reproducing relation in which attention, identity, incentives or obligations increasingly depend on the loop continuing.
questions: Does interaction reproduce the same system?

closure.label: Closed depth
closure.description: Near-zero viable circulation: blocked exits, totalized identity, terminal symbolic separation or compounded disintegration.
questions: Is any truthful exit still available?
Can a boundary, accountability or repair path be recovered?

threshold.label: Door / choice
threshold.description: A regime-changing junction where recognition, responsibility, release, refusal, repair or another real choice can alter the relation.
questions: What must change for this not to be repetition?

transformed_recurrence.label: Changed recurrence
transformed_recurrence.description: The same thematic material returns, but the relation has acquired new capability, perspective, boundary or orientation.
questions: What is actually different this time?
What capability or boundary now exists that did not before?

living_root.label: Living Root
living_root.description: Memory and consequence retained without requiring continued conflict; the past becomes usable nourishment rather than compulsory repetition.
questions: Can the history remain visible without controlling the future?

generative.label: Generative branch / fruit
generative.description: Integrated material produces independent capacity, reciprocal nourishment, future seed or useful work beyond the original center.
questions: Does this make other nodes more capable?
Can value continue without permanent dependence?

habitation.label: Garden / Rooms
habitation.description: Multiple differentiated branches coexist with protected boundaries, passage and cultivation.
questions: Can they cooperate without capture or forced sameness?

transmission.label: Faithful transmission
transmission.description: Knowledge, message, seed or orientation is relayed while preserving source context and recipient agency.
questions: Can the recipient verify or refuse?

integration.label: Crown / accountable integration
integration.description: Many lower perspectives are compressed into judgment, strategy, protection or service while retaining a route back to evidence.
questions: What responsibility follows from greater vantage?

orientation.label: North of North / criteria
orientation.description: Criteria by which competing orientations are themselves tested: truth, life, coherence, repair, responsibility and service.
questions: Can the criterion descend into observable consequences?

return.label: Return to the Plane
return.description: Integrated insight returns as service, law, protection, infrastructure, cultivation, knowledge or another observable consequence.
questions: Who gained capacity, safety, clarity or agency?

transitions.condition: the event leaves material, documentary, relational or historical consequence
stored consequence repeatedly returns without closure or usable context
incentives, identity or attention increasingly depend on recurrence
revision, reciprocity and viable future capacity approach zero
provenance is usable enough to support agency and a real regime-changing choice
the loop can be named without freezing participants into the loop
a viable exit or repair channel is recovered
at least one truthful exit, boundary, accountability mechanism or repair path becomes possible
the relation demonstrably changes rather than merely renames the same loop
no changed relation is established
history remains accessible while agency and future capacity increase
retained experience produces independent capability or reciprocal value
multiple autonomous capacities can coexist with protected passage and boundaries
knowledge or capacity can travel without coercive dependence or destructive distortion
many perspectives can be integrated while preserving provenance and uncertainty
the integrated view can articulate what standards it uses and why
criteria become observable protection, repair, cultivation, law, knowledge or infrastructure
summit perspective produces useful D4 consequences rather than status alone
returned action creates new observable facts, outcomes and feedback
memory becomes compulsory reenactment or enemy-dependent identity
growth requires permanent dependence, enemy production, humiliation or extraction

transition_model.trace_rule: The public UI may show possible next states, but it must not infer which transition is true for a real person, community or event without evidence. It is a reasoning scaffold, not an automatic moral classifier.
movement_tests: What evidence establishes the current state?
What transformation operator is actually occurring?
What condition would have to become true for the proposed next state?
Does the relation become more generative or more dependent on repetition?
If it moves upward, what observable return to D4 would count as evidence of useful integration?

plane.label: Plane
plane.function: Where relations become observable as bodies, events, institutions, geography, evidence and consequence.
plane.question: What is actually happening in the world, and what can be sourced?

cross.label: Cross
cross.function: Plane × Axis: the operation that makes outward relation, downward root and upward integration simultaneously readable.
cross.question: Which direction is this relation taking, and what would change its direction?

knowledge.label: Knowledge / distinction
knowledge.function: Distinction makes memory, judgment, responsibility and choice possible; it can feed integration or unresolved repetition.
knowledge.question: What has become known, and is that knowledge becoming usable context or recurrent activation?

roots-of-ash.label: Roots of Ash
roots-of-ash.function: Stored consequence after rupture, burning, exhaustion or severance.
roots-of-ash.question: Does the residue become evidence and soil, or does it keep being reactivated as Mud?

roots-of-strife.label: Roots of Strife
roots-of-strife.function: Buried material that keeps reproducing conflict, dependency, capture or fragmentation.
roots-of-strife.question: What unresolved relation is being reproduced rather than metabolized?

tree-of-strife.label: Tree of Strife
tree-of-strife.function: A living system whose branches depend on unresolved conflict continuing.
tree-of-strife.question: What must remain unresolved for this system to keep reproducing itself?

wide-road.label: Wide Road
wide-road.function: The dispersive route where repetition becomes easier than a narrow regime-changing crossing.
wide-road.question: What makes continued repetition easier than transformation here?

swamp.label: Swamp
swamp.function: Accumulated entanglement, stagnant circulation and self-reproducing conflict ecology.
swamp.question: Where are exit, agency, provenance or productive outflow blocked?

door.label: Door
door.function: The regime-changing junction where a relation can be released, repaired, refused, transformed or routed.
door.question: What concrete condition would prove this crossing changed the relation?

spiral.label: Spiral
spiral.function: Return to related material at a changed level rather than a closed loop at the same level.
spiral.question: What is actually different on this recurrence?

ladder.label: Ladder
ladder.function: Ordered passage through thresholds; the experiential route of changed recurrence along the Axis.
ladder.question: Which threshold has been crossed, and what capability exists afterward?

living-root.label: Living Root
living-root.function: Memory and consequence preserved without compulsory reenactment; the past becomes nourishment.
living-root.question: Can the history stay visible without controlling the future?

tree-of-life.label: Tree of Life
tree-of-life.function: Integrated experience becomes branch, fruit, reciprocal nourishment and future seed.
tree-of-life.question: Does the structure make other nodes more capable without permanent dependence?

garden.label: Garden / Rooms
garden.function: Differentiated branches coexist with boundaries, passage, cultivation and room to remain distinct.
garden.question: Can plurality remain connected without capture or flattening?

rooms.label: Rooms
rooms.function: Protected differentiated spaces inside a larger relational whole.
rooms.question: Can each room keep identity, boundary and passage while contributing to the whole?

heaven.label: Heaven
heaven.function: Upper project-symbolic field of integrated perspective, evaluation, clarity and responsibility.
heaven.question: What responsibility follows from the wider view, and how does it return to D4?

crown.label: Crown
crown.function: Summit compression of many perspectives into accountable judgment, orientation and service.
crown.question: What information was compressed, and what useful return follows?

north.label: North / North of North
north.function: Source-facing criterion selection: deciding what deserves to count as orienting truth, life, repair, responsibility and service.
north.question: By what standard is the standard itself judged?

gardener.label: Gardener
gardener.function: Cultivation, protection, pruning, soil repair and practical return of integrated orientation to the Plane.
gardener.question: What becomes more capable, nourished, protected or repairable in the world?

repair.label: Repair
repair.function: The return route that turns residue into provenance, recovers agency, crosses a threshold and restores generativity.
repair.question: What has to become true for repetition to become changed relation?

fruit.label: Fruit
fruit.function: Manifest result by which a claimed integration can be evaluated in the inhabited world.
fruit.question: What observable capacity, nourishment, truth, repair or service was actually produced?

transition_model.concept_trace_rule: Concept traces are entry points into relation states, not claims that a symbol is permanently identical with one state. Operators such as Cross, Wide Road and Repair describe movement; roles such as Gardener describe a return function; domains such as Plane and Heaven describe context.
